Description: Internal generative AI assistant (enterprise LLM accessed through the cloud provider) used by employees for drafting, summarization, and coding help
Affected_Persons: Employees; customers whose data is entered
Data_Processed: Internal documents, code; risk that employees enter PHI
Other_Regulatory_Considerations: HIPAA (if PHI entered; BAA in place with cloud provider)

Description: Customer-facing chatbot on the support portal. Answers product questions using retrieval over help-center articles and can open or update support tickets
AI_Type: Generative AI with RAG and tool use
Built_or_Bought: Built on a third-party general-purpose AI model
Data_Processed: Help-center content, ticket metadata; customers may paste PHI into chats
Decision_Impact: Medium - incorrect guidance could cause product misconfiguration
EU_Key_Provisions: Art. 50(1) disclosure that users are interacting with AI; Art. 4

Description: Machine learning model that predicts each patient's 30-day hospital readmission risk. Scores are shown to hospital care managers to prioritize follow-up outreach
Data_Processed: PHI from customer EHR integrations: diagnoses, prior admissions, demographics, payer
Decision_Impact: High - influences which patients receive follow-up care
EU_AI_Act_Tier: Likely high risk (Annex I via EU MDR) - pending regulatory determination
EU_Key_Provisions: Art. 6(1) and Annex I; Arts. 9-15 provider requirements; Art. 72 post-market monitoring; Art. 73 serious incident reporting
EU_Applicable_From: 2 Aug 2028 (if confirmed high-risk under Annex I)
Other_Regulatory_Considerations: EU MDR software qualification; FDA clinical decision support device status; HIPAA (BAA permitted uses for training data); customers' HHS Section 1557 obligations (45 CFR 92.210)

Description: Forecasts daily patient volumes per hospital unit so nurse managers can plan staffing levels. Produces aggregate forecasts only
Data_Processed: Aggregate admission and census counts (no individual-level output)
EU_AI_Act_Tier: Minimal risk (would become high risk under Annex III(4) if extended to allocate shifts to individual workers)
EU_Key_Provisions: Art. 4; monitor roadmap for Annex III(4)(b)
Other_Regulatory_Considerations: US state automated decision-making laws if extended to individual workers

Description: AI features embedded in third-party tools: meeting note-taker, AI coding assistant, sales call-intelligence platform (includes voice-based sentiment and emotion analysis)
Data_Processed: Meeting recordings, source code, sales call audio
Decision_Impact: Medium - data exposure; voice emotion inference on employees
EU_AI_Act_Tier: Prohibited practice if used for emotion recognition in the workplace (Art. 5(1)(f)); otherwise minimal
EU_Key_Provisions: Art. 5(1)(f) emotion recognition in the workplace; Art. 4
Other_Regulatory_Considerations: Two-party consent recording laws; HIPAA (if PHI discussed on recorded calls); vendor contracts

Description: AI feature in the applicant tracking system that scores and ranks job applicants against the job description
Affected_Persons: Job applicants (US and from 2027 the Netherlands)
EU_AI_Act_Tier: High risk (Annex III(4)(a)) for EU candidates
EU_Key_Provisions: Art. 26 deployer obligations; Art. 86 right to explanation; Art. 4
Other_Regulatory_Considerations: Colorado SB 26-189 (effective 1 Jan 2027) if applicable; NYC Local Law 144 for NYC roles; EEOC and Title VII disparate impact
